1.text: Nuko ku munsi umwe muri iyo, yigishirizaga abantu mu rusengero avuga ubutumwa bwiza, abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi hamwe n'abakuru bajya aho ari.

2.text: Baramubwira bati “Tubwire. Ni butware ki bugutera gukora ibi? Cyangwa se ni nde wabuguhaye?”

3.text: Arabasubiza ati “Nanjye reka mbabaze ijambo mumbwire.

4.text: Kubatiza kwa Yohana kwavuye he? Ni mu ijuru cyangwa mu bantu?”

5.text: Biburanya mu mitima yabo bati “Nituvuga tuti ‘Kwavuye mu ijuru’, aratubaza ati ‘Ni iki cyababujije kumwemera?’

6.text: Kandi nituvuga tuti ‘Kwavuye mu bantu’, abantu bose baradutera amabuye kuko bemera ko Yohana yari umuhanuzi.”

7.text: Nuko bamusubiza yuko batazi aho kwavuye.

8.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Nuko rero nanjye simbabwira ubutware buntera gukora ibyo ubwo ari bwo.”

9.text: Atangira gucira abantu uyu mugani ati “Hariho umuntu wateye uruzabibu, asigamo abahinzi ajya mu kindi gihugu, atindayo.

10.text: Igihe cyo gusarura imyaka gisohoye, atuma umugaragu kuri ba bahinzi ngo bamuhe ku mbuto z'imizabibu, ariko abahinzi baramukubita, baramwirukana agenda ubusa.

11.text: Yongera gutuma undi mugaragu na we baramukubita, baramuhemura agenda amāra masa.

12.text: Yongera gutuma n'uwa gatatu, uwo baramukomeretsa, baramwirukana.

13.text: Nyir'uruzabibu aravuga ati ‘Noneho mbigenze nte? Reka ntume umwana wanjye nkunda, ahari none we bazamwubaha.’

14.text: Ariko ba bahinzi bamubonye bajya inama bati ‘Uyu ni we mutware. Nimucyo tumwice ubutware bube ubwacu.’

15.text: Bamwirukana mu ruzabibu, baramwica.“Mbese nyir'uruzabibu nabimenya azabagenza ate?

16.text: Azaza arimbure abo bahinzi, uruzabibu aruhe abandi.”Abantu babyumvise baravuga bati “Biragatsindwa.”

17.text: Arabitegereza arababwira ati “None se ibi byanditswe ni ibiki ngo‘Ibuye abubatsi banze,Ni ryo ryahindutse irikomeza imfuruka?’

18.text: Uzagwira iryo buye wese azavunagurika, ariko uwo rizagwira rizamugira ifu.”

19.text: Uwo mwanya abanditsi n'abatambyi bakuru bashaka kumufata, kuko bamenye yuko ari bo yaciriyeho uwo mugani, ariko batinya rubanda.

20.text: Baramugenza, batuma abatasi bigize nk'abakiranutsi ngo bakūre impamvu mu byo avuga, bahereko babone uko bamushyīra Umutegeka, na we amucire urubanza.

21.text: Baramubaza bati “Mwigisha, tuzi yuko uvuga neza, kandi ukigisha ibitunganye ntiwite ku cyubahiro cy'abantu, ahubwo wigisha inzira y'Imana by'ukuri.

22.text: Mbese amategeko yemera ko duha Kayisari umusoro, cyangwa ntiyemera?”

23.text: Ariko amenye uburiganya bwabo arababwira ati

24.text: “Nimunyereke idenariyo.” Ati “Ishusho n'izina biyiriho ni ibya nde?”Baramusubiza bati “Ni ibya Kayisari.”

25.text: Arababwira ati “Nuko rero ibya Kayisari mubihe Kayisari, iby'Imana mubihe Imana.”

26.text: Muri ayo magambo ashubirije imbere y'abantu ntibashobora kubona ijambo na rimwe ryatuma bamurega, batangarira ibyo abashubije baraceceka.

27.text: Abasadukayo bamwe bahakanaga yuko ari nta wuzuka, baza aho ari baramubaza bati

28.text: “Mwigisha, Mose yatwandikiye yuko mwene se w'umuntu napfa afite umugore batarabyarana, mwene se azahungure uwo mugore acikure mwene se.

29.text: Nuko habayeho abavandimwe barindwi: uwa mbere arongora umugeni apfa batarabyarana,

31.text: n'uwa gatatu aramuhungura, nuko bose uko ari barindwi bapfa batyo badasize abana.

32.text: Hanyuma wa mugore na we arapfa.

33.text: None se mu izuka azaba ari muka nde muri bose, ko bose uko ari barindwi bamugize umugore?”

34.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Abana b'iyi si bararongora, bagashyingirwa,

35.text: ariko abemerewe kuzagera muri ya si yindi, bakaba bakwiriye no kugera ku kuzuka mu bapfuye, ntibazarongora kandi ntibazashyingirwa,

36.text: kandi ntibazaba bagishobora gupfa kuko bazamera nk'abamarayika, bakaba ari abana b'Imana kuko ari abana b'umuzuko.

37.text: Ariko ibyemeza yuko abapfuye bazuka, Mose na we yabigaragarije ku byabereye kuri cya Gihuru, ubwo yitaga Uwiteka Imana ya Aburahamu n'Imana ya Isaka n'Imana ya Yakobo.

38.text: Nuko rero Imana si Imana y'abapfuye, ahubwo ni iy'abazima kuko bose kuri yo ari bazima.”

39.text: Bamwe mu banditsi baramusubiza bati “Mwigisha, uvuze neza.”

41.text: Arababaza ati “Bavuga bate yuko Kristo ari mwene Dawidi,

42.text: ko Dawidi ubwe avuga mu gitabo cya Zaburi ati‘Uwiteka yabwiye Umwami wanjye ati:Icara iburyo bwanjye,

43.text: Ugeze aho nzashyira abanzi bawe munsi y'ibirenge byawe?’

44.text: Mbese ko Dawidi amwita Umwami, none yabasha ate no kuba umwana we?”

45.text: Nuko abwira abigishwa be abantu bose bumva ati

46.text: “Mwirinde abanditsi bakunda kugenda bambaye ibishura, bagakunda kuramukirizwa mu maguriro, no kwicara ku ntebe z'icyubahiro mu masinagogi no mu myanya y'abakuru, bari mu birori.

47.text: Barya ingo z'abapfakazi, kandi bakavuga amashengesho y'urudaca baryarya. Abo bazacirwaho iteka rirusha ayandi kuba ribi.”
